key_idea: Computers are interchangeable and work is divisible, so the only constraint is that for every solve time s the total work of problems solved by time s fits into k*s computer-time; earliest-deadline-first achieves this.
sketch: Drop unsolved problems, sort the rest by solve time, keep a running sum of required time, and take the maximum over prefixes of ceil(prefix_sum / s). O(n log n). Pitfalls: ignore s=-1 entries, use ceiling division, and with equal solve times evaluate after including all of them (taking the max over every prefix handles this since later prefixes with the same s dominate).
